items.title: Industrial humanoid robots for logistics: System simulation, the missing link between Physical AI and factory deployment
items.source: Siemens Digital Industries Software, Simcenter blog
items.excerpt: Siemens describes cross-checking a Simcenter Amesim multiphysics digital twin against an Erlangen factory logistics robot proof-of-concept. Siemens reports hardware throughput of 60 tote moves per hour and over 90% pick-and-place success.

items.title: Engineering the bowling experience with Simcenter X
items.source: Siemens Digital Industries Software, Simcenter blog
items.excerpt: Siemens presents a multiphysics bowling demonstration combining Amesim trajectory simulation, HEEDS design exploration, STAR-CCM+ aerodynamics and Simcenter 3D/Nastran structural impact analysis through Simcenter X.

items.title: Extend thermal characterization to high-power ICs and GaN devices
items.source: Siemens Digital Industries Software, Simcenter blog
items.excerpt: Siemens introduces a high-power sensing current generator for Simcenter Micred T3STER, targeting high-power ICs and low-resistance GaN devices. Measurements and compact thermal RC models can feed Simcenter Flotherm and FLOEFD model calibration.

items.title: AI in PLM: Turning product data into product lifecycle intelligence
items.source: Siemens Digital Industries Software, Teamcenter blog
items.excerpt: Siemens explains how Teamcenter Copilot uses lifecycle context for engineering-change impact analysis, requirements quality, test generation and workflow automation. It describes AI-supported BOM work, Microsoft 365 integration and agentic workflows.

items.title: Designcenter | Tips and Tricks | Partitions Worksets and Smart Discovery
items.source: Siemens Digital Industries Software, Designcenter blog
items.excerpt: Siemens demonstrates complex CAD assembly management using Partitions to reorganize systems, Smart Discovery to filter nearby or volume-defined components, and Worksets to save reusable assembly views.

items.title: Polarion X 2606 – What’s New and Noteworthy
items.source: Siemens Digital Industries Software, Polarion blog
items.excerpt: Siemens announces Polarion X 2606 with a new Copilot API for custom reports, scripts and widgets. The release expands REST integration and updates the Simulink connector; Copilot requires an add-on and the customer's own LLM connection.

items.title: Large product structures at scale: Clone and reuse up to one million parts with Teamcenter
items.source: Siemens Digital Industries Software, Teamcenter blog
items.excerpt: Siemens details Teamcenter 2606 structure-cloning improvements using bulk processing and parallel execution for assemblies containing up to one million parts, while preserving engineering relationships and context. Aerospace is a stated target industry.

items.title: Designcenter | Tips and Tricks | Steel Outfitting
items.source: Siemens Digital Industries Software, Designcenter blog
items.excerpt: Siemens demonstrates Structure Designer workflows for steel outfitting: converting sketches into 3D platforms, adding configurable handrails, and checking structures in the context of a full ship assembly with linked model updates.

items.title: Synopsys Powers Autonomous Engineering with a Broad Portfolio of Long-Horizon Agents and Autopilot Platform
items.excerpt: Synopsys announced AgentEngineer and Autopilot for multi-step engineering workflows, including simulation and analysis. The portfolio covers tasks such as combustion and resonance; the company says more than 50 engagements are underway, with availability planned for year-end 2026.
items.query: direct exploration: Ansys press releases → Synopsys Newsroom → AgentEngineer blog → linked press release

items.title: Synopsys and Amazon Announce Strategic, Multi-year IP Agreement for Custom Silicon; Collaboration Also Extends to Cloud and AI-Powered Engineering
items.excerpt: Synopsys says its expanded Amazon agreement includes simulation, agentic AI and work to accelerate multiphysics on AWS Trainium and Graviton. The partners plan physics-based simulation and custom AI-agent workflows for designing, analyzing, optimizing and validating chips and systems.
items.query: direct exploration: Ansys press releases → Synopsys Newsroom

items.title: Turn Down the Noise, Turn Up the Experience: Engineer Quieter Products With Simulation
items.excerpt: Ansys describes linked electromagnetic, CFD and structural workflows for noise and vibration. Examples connect Maxwell/Motor-CAD forces to Mechanical, Fluent pressure data to structural response, and Mechanical Sound Insights or PyAnsys Sound to psychoacoustic evaluation.

items.title: What’s New in ENOVIA R2026x FD04
items.excerpt: Dassault describes ENOVIA R2026x FD04 AI additions: document summaries and AURA support for change impacts, generative engineering BOMs and release readiness. The post also details improved resource allocation and supplier-item sourcing definitions.

items.title: SYSTRA and Dassault Systèmes Enter into a Technological Collaboration Around a New Generation of Virtual Twins for Transport Infrastructures
items.excerpt: SYSTRA and Dassault announced collaboration on virtual twins for rail and transport infrastructure. Their stated aim is to connect data, models and scientific AI for lifecycle design, simulation and decisions, using the 3DEXPERIENCE platform.

items.title: From 90,000 Requirements to Minutes: How CATIA Magic Automation and AI Are Changing MBSE
items.excerpt: A Dassault interview with Enola Technologies describes CATIA Magic Open API scripts processing over 90,000 legacy requirements and linking verification/test data. Enola reports reducing a months-long process to minutes; AI and SysML v2 are discussed as further opportunities.

items.title: From Feature Trees to Surface Sculpting: How CATIA ICEM Design Experience is changing motorsport surfacing
items.excerpt: Origin Engineering’s Daniel Vass describes CATIA IDX’s hybrid parametric and surface-sculpting approach. A compound-curvature example uses fewer construction elements and spans; the interview explains implications for CFD meshing, composite lay-up and downstream production geometry.

items.title: Making MBSE More Accessible: Benjamin W. Stirgwolt on CATIA Magic, Productivity and AI
items.excerpt: A Dassault interview with former Belcan MBSE director Benjamin Stirgwolt discusses connected requirements and architecture in CATIA Magic. It outlines possible AI assistance for requirements review, missing-information detection and model queries, alongside implementation planning and usability.

items.title: Dassault Systèmes Brings Virtual Twins and Industrial AI to the Paris Motor Show 2026
items.excerpt: Dassault announced its Paris Motor Show participation for October 12–18, presenting virtual twins and industrial AI for vehicle engineering. The notice links virtual performance prediction with faster mechanical and physics-driven design and lists two engineering/agentic-AI conference sessions.

items.title: Use existing structural and fluid data to train Simcenter PhysicsAI
items.source: Siemens Digital Industries Software / Simcenter blog
items.excerpt: Siemens describes training PhysicsAI on existing structural and fluid solver archives to predict fields on new geometry. The workflow combines geometric deep learning, several model architectures and validation checks while retaining full-fidelity solvers for final verification.
items.query: Direct exploration: https://altair.com/blog redirected to the Simcenter blog; latest-post link.
items.organization: Siemens Digital Industries Software; guest author Tyler Haggin, COO of TrueInsight LLC

items.title: When lightweighting is not enough: an engineer’s search for a better structural design
items.source: Siemens Digital Industries Software / Simcenter blog
items.excerpt: A Siemens engineering study uses OptiStruct on an automotive engine cradle to examine topology choices across steel/aluminum, recycled sourcing, cost and CO2 pricing. Its reported results show that mass-only and emissions-oriented objectives can favor different feasible designs.
items.query: Direct exploration: https://altair.com/blog redirected to the Simcenter blog; latest-post link.

items.title: Hexagon launches HYPERSCAN SR, simplifying inspection on site and in the field
items.excerpt: Hexagon announced a wireless optical-tracking 3D scanner for production, supplier-site and field inspection. The company describes dynamic tracking, direct transfer to Geomagic or PolyWorks, and an automation integrator kit. This is adjacent to the core CAE/aerospace scope.

items.title: PhysicsX Launches Asia-Pacific Hub in Singapore to Scale AI-Powered Industrial Engineering Across the Region
items.excerpt: PhysicsX announced a Singapore engineering hub and a five-year S$40 million A*STAR collaboration on AI-powered engineering simulation and manufacturing. It reports 20 local employees and a goal exceeding 100 within three years.
items.query: engineering AI simulation CAD aerospace September October 2026 PhysicsX Neural Concept nTop

items.title: AI in Mechanical Engineering - How Is It Used?
items.excerpt: Neural Concept published a technical overview of geometry-aware AI linking CAD, CAE and PLM. It discusses held-out validation, training-domain limits and design-space exploration; its general speedup claims are vendor statements without a new reproducible benchmark.
